#
# Generation Configuration Options
#
# More information about Mythic pack generation features can be found here:
# https://git.mythiccraft.io/mythiccraft/mythiccrucible/-/wikis/ResourcePack-Generator
#
Generation:

  #================================================================================
  # General Generator Options
  #================================================================================
  Namespace: mythic                 # Namespace to save everything under
  GenerateOnStartup: true           # If the pack should auto-generate on server startup
  MergeModelEngine: true            # Whether to merge ModelEngine files if available
  MergeHappyHUD: true               # Whether to merge HappyHUD files if available
  MergeMythicHUD: true
  ZipPack: true                     # Whether to zip the pack after completion. Required for deployment.
  LegacyNoteblocksSupport: true     # Supports noteblocks id from Oraxen. Disabling it will allow to use the harp instrument and increasing the limit of 800 maximum blocks to 1150

  #================================================================================
  # Automatic Deployment Options
  # - Used to automatically deploy the pack to an end-point once it's generated
  #================================================================================
  Deployment:
    Enabled: false                  # Whether to enable automatic deployment
    Type: SELFHOST                  # Can currently be SELFHOST or S3
    SelfHosting:
      Port: 8080
    S3:
      Storage:
        Key: pack
        Bucket: packs
      Authentication:
        Endpoint: ''
        AccessKey: ''
        SecretKey: ''
    AutoSend:                       # Automatically sending the pack to players
      Enabled: false
      SendOnUpdate: false
      PublicURL: https://s3.yourcoolwebsite.com
      Force: false                #Force players to accept the pack or be kicked
      Prompt: "This server requires a resource pack to play!"         #Prompt to send to players when being sent resource pack

  #================================================================================
  # Custom Armor Generation Settings
  # - These settings affect custom armor generation.
  #================================================================================
  CustomArmor:
    DefaultMethod: TRIMS
    GenerateOptifineFiles: true
    Trims:
      Enabled: false
      GenerateDataPack: true
      HideBaseArmor: []
      ConvertBaseArmor: false
    Shaders:
      Enabled: false
      Shader: lessfancypants

  #================================================================================
  # Font Image Generation Settings
  #================================================================================
  FontImages:
    StartingCharacter: "\u5001"

#
# Item Configuration Options
#
# More information about Mythic item features can be found here:
# https://git.mythiccraft.io/mythiccraft/MythicMobs/-/wikis/Items/Items
#
Configuration:

  #================================================================================
  # Item Updater
  #================================================================================
  ItemUpdating:
    Enabled: true

  #================================================================================
  # FancyDrop Everything (EXPERIMENTAL)
  #================================================================================
  EnableFancyDropEffectsEverywhere: false

  #================================================================================
  # Item Defaults - choose what item options default to
  #================================================================================
  DefaultItemOptions:
    Material: STONE
    PreventEnchanting: false            # Can be true or false
    PreventCrafting: modeled            # Can be true, false, modeled, or default
    PreventAnviling: default            # Can be true, false, modeled, or default
    PreventSmithing: default            # Can be true, false, modeled, or default

  #================================================================================
  # Item Skills (requires Crucible)
  #================================================================================
  ItemSkills:
    JoinDelay: 20                       # Delay when joining before items are scanned

  #================================================================================
  # Item Stats (requires Crucible)
  #================================================================================
  ItemStats:
    Rounding: 2                         # Default decimal places to round stats to when generated
    SaveRatios: false                   # Save generated stat ratios for the Item Updater

  #================================================================================
  # Custom Blocks (requires Crucible)
  #================================================================================
  CustomBlocks:
    SwapIsPickBlock: true               # Can be true or false

  #================================================================================
  # Custom Furniture (requires Crucible)
  #================================================================================
  Furniture:
    DefaultType: DISPLAY                # Can be DISPLAY, ARMOR_STAND or ITEM_FRAME

  #- hasaura WingsBind_WarnStacking orElsecast ECWings_v1-WingsBind-WarnStacking
  - stringequals{val1="<caster.item.offhand.nbt.MYTHIC_TYPE>";val2="UNDEFINED"} orElsecast ECWings_v1-WingsBind-AlreadyMythicItem

  - effect:firework{t=BALL_LARGE;d=0;f=true;tr=true} @selflocation{y=1}

  - setItemNBT{slot=OFFHAND;key=ECWings;value=Enable} @self

  #- command{c="item modify entity <caster.name> weapon.offhand minecraft<&co>setcount_a1"} @self

  - setItemNBT{slot=OFFHAND;key=ECWings-Type;value=Aether-Wings} @self ?holding{m=ECWings_v1-Wings-Aether}

  - setItemNBT{slot=OFFHAND;key=ECWings-Type;value=Harpy-Wings} @self ?holding{m=ECWings_v1-Wings-Harpy}

  - message{m="&ewith &bAether-Wings"} ?stringequals{val1="<caster.item.offhand.nbt.ECWings-Type>";val2="Aether-Wings"}

### Joy interaction -----------------------------------------------------

rduck_call_joy:
  Skills:
  - CancelEvent
  - skill{s=rduck_joy}
  
rduck_joy:
  Skills:
  - state{state=joy;n=false;speed=1} @Self  
  - potion{type=SLOW;duration=65;level=100;p=false;force=true} @Self  


### Sneeze interaction -----------------------------------------------------

rduck_call_sneeze:
  Skills:
  - CancelEvent
  - skill{s=rduck_sneeze}
  
rduck_sneeze:
  Skills:
  - state{state=sneeze;n=false;speed=1} @Self  
  - potion{type=SLOW;duration=35;level=100;p=false;force=true} @Self

  - state{state=head_spin;n=false;speed=1} @Self

# ENTER VEHICLE LEFT SIDE #
VEHICLE_CAR_enter_driver:
  Cooldown: 1
  TriggerConditions:
  - fieldofview{angle=90;r=90}
  - holding{m=VEHICLE_PAINT_*} false
  Conditions:
  - varequals{var=caster.flooded;val=true} false
  - modelhasdriver false
  Skills:
  - setvar{var=caster.alarm_setoff;val=false;type=STRING} @self
  - sound{s=littleroom_vehicle_pack:vehicle.door_shut;v=1;p=<random.float.-0.8to1.1>;sc=HOSTILE;delay=8} @self
  - sound{s=littleroom_vehicle_pack:vehicle.car_start;v=1;sc=HOSTILE;delay=5} @self
  - setvar{var=caster.engine;val=started;type=STRING;delay=20} @self
  - partvis{p=head_light;v=true} @self
  - partvis{p=root_driver;child=true;v=true;em=true} @self
  - modelplayerskin{p=driver_head} @trigger
  - state{s=enter;p=14} @self
  - mountmodel{mode=[
      - move{front=<skill.var.meg:front>;side=0} ?!variableEquals{var=caster.flooded;val=true}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_exit_driver} @trigger ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:sneak;value=>0}
      - setvar{var=caster.honk;val=false;type=STRING} @self ?variableEquals{var=skill.meg:jump;value=0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_blinker_left} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:side;value=>0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_blinker_right} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:side;value=<0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_blinker_reset} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:side;value=-0.1to0.1}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_honk} @self ?variableEquals{var=skill.meg:jump;value=1}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_forward_set} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:front;value=>0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_reverse_set} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:front;value=<0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_direction_stop} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:front;value=0}
    ]} @trigger

# enter left side #

VEHICLE_BIKE_enter:
  Cooldown: 1
  TriggerConditions:
  - holding{m=VEHICLE_PAINT_*} false
  - holding{m=VEHICLE_WRENCH} false
  - holding{i=stick} false
  - fieldofview{angle=180;r=90} orElseCast VEHICLE_BIKE_enter_right
  Conditions:
  - (varequals{var=caster.bike_toppled;val=front} || varequals{var=caster.bike_toppled;val=side}) castinstead VEHICLE_BIKE_pickup
  - varequals{var=caster.flooded;val=true} false
  - modelhasdriver false
  Skills:
  - sudoskill{s=VEHICLE_BIKE_hide_driver;cat=true} @trigger
  - sound{s=littleroom_vehicle_pack:vehicle.bike_start;v=1;sc=HOSTILE;delay=5} @self
  - setvar{var=caster.engine;val=started;type=STRING;delay=20} @self
  - partvis{p=head_light;v=true} @self
  - partvis{p=root_driver;child=true;v=true;em=true} @self
  - modelplayerskin{p=driver_head} @trigger
  - state{s=enter;p=14} @self
  - mountmodel{mode=[
      - move{front=<skill.var.meg:front>;side=0} ?!variableEquals{var=caster.flooded;val=true}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_BIKE_exit} @trigger ?variableEquals{var=skill.meg:sneak;value=1}
      - setvar{var=caster.honk;val=false;type=STRING} @self ?variableEquals{var=skill.meg:jump;value=0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_BIKE_lean_left} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:side;value=>0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_BIKE_lean_right} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:side;value=<0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_BIKE_lean_reset} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:side;value=-0.1to0.1}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_BIKE_wheelie} @self ?variableEquals{var=skill.meg:jump;value=1}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_BIKE_forward_set} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:front;value=>0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_BIKE_reverse_set} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:front;value=<0}

    ]} @trigger

  Cooldown: 1
  TriggerConditions:
  - holding{m=VEHICLE_PAINT_*} false
  - fieldofview{angle=90;r=90}

  - varequals{var=caster.flooded;val=true} false

  - modelplayerskin{p=driver_head} @trigger
  - state{s=enter_driver;p=14} @self

      - move{front=<skill.var.meg:front>;side=0} ?!variableEquals{var=caster.flooded;val=true}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_TRUCK_exit_driver} @trigger ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:sneak;value=>0}
      - setvar{var=caster.honk;val=false;type=STRING} @self ?variableEquals{var=skill.meg:jump;value=0}

      - skill{s=VEHICLE_TRUCK_blinker_reset} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:side;value=-0.1to0.1}

# ENTER VEHICLE LEFT SIDE #
VEHICLE_CAR_POLICE_enter_driver:
  Cooldown: 1
  TriggerConditions:
  - fieldofview{angle=90;r=90}
  Conditions:
  - varequals{var=caster.flooded;val=true} false
  - modelhasdriver false
  Skills:
  - setvar{var=caster.alarm_setoff;val=false;type=STRING} @self
  - sound{s=littleroom_vehicle_pack:vehicle.door_shut;v=1;p=<random.float.-0.8to1.1>;sc=HOSTILE;delay=8} @self
  - sound{s=littleroom_vehicle_pack:vehicle.car_start;v=1;sc=HOSTILE;delay=5} @self
  - setvar{var=caster.engine;val=started;type=STRING;delay=20} @self
  - partvis{p=head_light;v=true} @self
  - partvis{p=root_driver;child=true;v=true;em=true} @self
  - modelplayerskin{p=driver_head} @trigger
  - state{s=enter;p=14} @self
  - mountmodel{mode=[
      - move{front=<skill.var.meg:front>;side=0} ?!variableEquals{var=caster.flooded;val=true}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_POLICE_exit_driver} @trigger ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:sneak;value=>0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_POLICE_blinker_left} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:side;value=>0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_POLICE_blinker_right} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:side;value=<0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_POLICE_blinker_reset} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:side;value=-0.1to0.1}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_POLICE_toggle_siren} @self ?variableEquals{var=skill.meg:jump;value=1}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_POLICE_forward_set} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:front;value=>0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_POLICE_reverse_set} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:front;value=<0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_POLICE_direction_stop} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:front;value=0}
    ]} @trigger
  
# HIDE DRIVER #
VEHICLE_CAR_POLICE_hide_driver:
  Skills:
  - potion{type=DAMAGE_RESISTANCE;l=4;d=10;p=false;i=false} @self
  - potion{type=INVISIBILITY;l=4;d=10;p=false;i=false} @self
  - hide{d=20} @Server
  
# EXIT DRIVER #
VEHICLE_CAR_POLICE_exit_driver:
  Cooldown: 1
  Conditions:
  - varequals{var=caster.driverexit;val=true} false
  Skills:
  - stopsound{s=littleroom_vehicle_pack:vehicle.car_accelerate_idle_60_tick;v=1;sc=HOSTILE} @pir{r=4}
  - setvar{var=caster.engine;val=stopped;type=STRING} @self
  - sound{s=littleroom_vehicle_pack:vehicle.door_shut;v=1;p=<random.float.-0.8to1.1>;sc=HOSTILE;delay=10} @self
  - setvar{var=caster.driverexit;val="true";type=STRING;d=10} @self
  - partvis{p=root_driver;child=true;em=true;delay=3} @self
  - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_POLICE_direction_stop} @self
  - state{s=exit;p=14} @self
  - sudoskill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_POLICE_show_driver} @trigger
  - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_POLICE_exit_lights_time_out;delay=80} @self
  - delay 3
  - dismountmodel @trigger

# UNHIDE DRIVER #
VEHICLE_CAR_POLICE_show_driver:
  Skills:
  - potionclear{type=INVISIBILITY;repeat=4;repeati=1;delay=3} @self
  - showEntity{delay=3} @Server
  
# LIGHTS TIME OUT #
VEHICLE_CAR_POLICE_exit_lights_time_out:
  Conditions:
  - modelhasdriver false
  Skills:
  - partvis{p=head_light;v=false} @self
  - partvis{p=brake_light;v=false} @self

# ENTER VEHICLE LEFT SIDE #
VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_enter_driver:
  Cooldown: 1
  TriggerConditions:
  - fieldofview{angle=90;r=90}
  Conditions:
  - varequals{var=caster.flooded;val=true} false
  - modelhasdriver false
  Skills:
  - setvar{var=caster.alarm_setoff;val=false;type=STRING} @self
  - sound{s=littleroom_vehicle_pack:vehicle.door_shut;v=1;p=<random.float.-0.8to1.1>;sc=HOSTILE;delay=8} @self
  - sound{s=littleroom_vehicle_pack:vehicle.car_start;v=1;sc=HOSTILE;delay=5} @self
  - setvar{var=caster.engine;val=started;type=STRING;delay=20} @self
  - partvis{p=head_light;v=true} @self
  - partvis{p=root_driver;child=true;v=true;em=true} @self
  - modelplayerskin{p=driver_head} @trigger
  - state{s=enter;p=14} @self
  - mountmodel{mode=[
      - move{front=<skill.var.meg:front>;side=0} ?!variableEquals{var=caster.flooded;val=true}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_exit_driver} @trigger ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:sneak;value=>0}
      - setvar{var=caster.honk;val=false;type=STRING} @self ?variableEquals{var=skill.meg:jump;value=0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_blinker_left} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:side;value=>0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_blinker_right} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:side;value=<0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_blinker_reset} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:side;value=-0.1to0.1}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_honk} @self ?variableEquals{var=skill.meg:jump;value=1}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_forward_set} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:front;value=>0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_reverse_set} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:front;value=<0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_direction_stop} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:front;value=0}
    ]} @trigger

# UNHIDE DRIVER #
VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_show_driver:
  Skills:
  - potionclear{type=INVISIBILITY;repeat=4;repeati=1;delay=3} @self
  - showEntity{delay=3} @Server
  
# LIGHTS TIME OUT #
VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_exit_lights_time_out:
  Conditions:
  - modelhasdriver false
  Skills:
  - partvis{p=head_light;v=false} @self
  - partvis{p=brake_light;v=false} @self
  
  
  
#####################
## PASSENGER ENTRY ##
#####################


VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_enter_passenger:
  Cooldown: 1
  Conditions:
  - varequals{var=caster.flooded;val=true} false
  - modelhaspassengers{mid=vehicle_car_taxi;p=passenger_seat} false
  TriggerConditions:
  - fieldofview{angle=90;r=270}
  Skills:
  - partvis{p=root_passenger;child=true;v=true;em=true} @self
  - sound{s=littleroom_vehicle_pack:vehicle.door_shut;v=1;p=<random.float.-0.8to1.1>;sc=HOSTILE;delay=10} @self
  - modelplayerskin{p=passenger_head} @trigger
  - state{s=enter_right;p=17} @self
  - mountmodel{d=false;
               mid=vehicle_car_taxi;
               p=passenger_seat;
               mode=[
               - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_exit_passenger} @trigger ?variableEquals{var=skill.meg:sneak;value=1}
               - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_passenger_to_driver} @trigger ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:side;value=>0}
               ]} @trigger
  
VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_hide_passenger:
  Skills:
  - potion{type=INVISIBILITY;l=4;d=10;p=false;i=false} @self
  - hide{d=20} @Server
  
  
# CHANGE SEATS TO DRIVER #
VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_passenger_to_driver:
  Cooldown: 1
  Conditions:
  - modelhasdriver false
  Skills:
  - dismountmodel{mid=vehicle_car_taxi;p=passenger_seat;d=false} @trigger
  - partvis{p=root_passenger;child=true;em=true;delay=3} @self
  - setvar{var=caster.alarm_setoff;val=false;type=STRING} @self
  - sound{s=littleroom_vehicle_pack:vehicle.car_start;v=1;sc=HOSTILE;delay=5} @self
  - setvar{var=caster.engine;val=started;type=STRING;delay=20} @self
  - partvis{p=head_light;v=true} @self
  - partvis{p=root_driver;child=true;v=true;em=true} @self
  - modelplayerskin{p=driver_head} @trigger
  - mountmodel{mode=[
      - move{front=<skill.var.meg:front>;side=0} ?!variableEquals{var=caster.flooded;val=true}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_exit_driver} @trigger ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:sneak;value=>0}
      - setvar{var=caster.honk;val=false;type=STRING} @self ?variableEquals{var=skill.meg:jump;value=0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_blinker_left} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:side;value=>0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_blinker_right} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:side;value=<0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_blinker_reset} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:side;value=-0.1to0.1}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_honk} @self ?variableEquals{var=skill.meg:jump;value=1}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_forward_set} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:front;value=>0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_reverse_set} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:front;value=<0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_direction_stop} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:front;value=0}
    ]} @trigger
  
VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_exit_passenger:
  Cooldown: 1
  Skills:
  - sound{s=littleroom_vehicle_pack:vehicle.door_shut;v=1;p=<random.float.-0.8to1.1>;sc=HOSTILE;delay=10} @self
  - partvis{p=root_passenger;child=true;em=true;delay=3} @self
  - sudoskill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_show_passenger} @trigger
  - state{s=exit_right;p=17} @self
  - delay 3
  - dismountmodel{mid=vehicle_car_taxi;p=passenger_seat;d=false} @trigger

VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_show_passenger:
  Skills:
  - potionclear{type=INVISIBILITY;repeat=4;repeati=1;delay=3} @self
  - showEntity{delay=3} @Server

  # start driving forward #
VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_forward_set:
  Conditions:
  - varequals{var=caster.flooded;val=true} false
  - varequals{var=caster.direction;val=forward} false
  - varequals{var=caster.driverexit;val=true} false
  Skills:
  - setvar{var=caster.direction;val=forward;type=STRING} @self
  - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_forward_acceleration} @self
  - partvis{p=brake_light;v=false} @self
  - partvis{p=backup_light} @self
  - e:p{p=block;m=dirt;a=5;repeat=4;repeati=1} @modelpart{pid=back_right_tire;em=false}
  - e:p{p=block;m=dirt;a=5;repeat=4;repeati=1} @modelpart{pid=back_left_tire;em=false}
  - state{s=start_forward;p=11} @self
  - state{s=forward} @self


# acceleration loop sound #
VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_acceleration_loop:
  Cooldown: 3
  Conditions:
  - varequals{var=caster.forward_speed;val=full} true
  Skills:
  - sound{s=littleroom_vehicle_pack:vehicle.car_accelerate_idle_60_tick;v=1;sc=HOSTILE} @self

# idle engine loop #
VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_idle_loop:
  Cooldown: 5
  Conditions:
  - modelhasdriver true
  - varequals{var=caster.forward_speed;val=full} false
  - varequals{var=caster.engine;val=started} true
  Skills:
  - sound{s=littleroom_vehicle_pack:vehicle.car_idle_100_tick;v=1;sc=HOSTILE} @self

 # acceleration system #
VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_forward_acceleration:

  - sound{s=littleroom_vehicle_pack:vehicle.car_accelerate_start;v=1;sc=HOSTILE} @self
  - setspeed{t=walking;s=0.5} @self
  - delay 10
  - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_forward_acceleration_2} @self
  
VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_forward_acceleration_2:

  - variableInRange{var=skill.meg:front;value=>0}
  Skills:

  - delay 10
  - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_forward_acceleration_3} @self
  
VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_forward_acceleration_3:

  - state{s=start_reverse;p=11} @self
  - state{s=reverse;p=1} @self

# stop #

VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_direction_stop:
  Conditions:
  - onground true
  - varequals{var=caster.direction;val=stop} false
  Skills:
  - stopsound{s=littleroom_vehicle_pack:vehicle.car_accelerate_start;v=1;sc=HOSTILE} @modelDriver
  - stopsound{s=littleroom_vehicle_pack:vehicle.car_accelerate_start;v=1;sc=HOSTILE} @modelPassengers
  - stopsound{s=littleroom_vehicle_pack:vehicle.car_accelerate_idle_60_tick;v=1;sc=HOSTILE} @modelDriver
  - stopsound{s=littleroom_vehicle_pack:vehicle.car_accelerate_idle_60_tick;v=1;sc=HOSTILE} @modelPassengers

  - partvis{p=backup_light} @self
  - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_direction_stop_forward} @self
  - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_direction_stop_reverse} @self
  - setvar{var=caster.direction;val=stop;type=STRING} @self
  - modstate{s=reverse;sp=0} @self
  - modstate{s=forward;sp=0} @self
  
VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_direction_stop_forward:
  Conditions:
  - varequals{var=caster.direction;val=forward} true
  Skills:
  - state{s=stop_forward;p=11} @self

VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_direction_stop_reverse:
  Conditions:
  - varequals{var=caster.direction;val=reverse} true
  Skills:
  - state{s=stop_reverse;p=11} @self

VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_forward_fullspeed:

  - setvar{var=caster.forward_speed;val=full;type=STRING} @self

VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_forward_fullspeed_reset:
  Conditions:
  - directionalVelocity{z=<0.75;relative=true} true
  Skills:
  - setvar{var=caster.forward_speed;val=false;type=STRING} @self

  TargetConditions:
  - blocktype{type=WATER} true
  Conditions:
  - varequals{var=caster.flooded;val=true} false
  Skills:

# ENTER VEHICLE LEFT SIDE #
VEHICLE_CAR_enter_driver:
  Cooldown: 1
  TriggerConditions:
  - fieldofview{angle=90;r=90}
  - holding{m=VEHICLE_PAINT_*} false
  Conditions:
  - varequals{var=caster.flooded;val=true} false
  - modelhasdriver false
  Skills:
  - setvar{var=caster.alarm_setoff;val=false;type=STRING} @self
  - sound{s=littleroom_vehicle_pack:vehicle.door_shut;v=1;p=<random.float.-0.8to1.1>;sc=HOSTILE;delay=8} @self
  - sound{s=littleroom_vehicle_pack:vehicle.car_start;v=1;sc=HOSTILE;delay=5} @self
  - setvar{var=caster.engine;val=started;type=STRING;delay=20} @self
  - partvis{p=head_light;v=true} @self
  - partvis{p=root_driver;child=true;v=true;em=true} @self
  - modelplayerskin{p=driver_body,driver_head,driver_rleg,driver_lleg,driver_rarm,driver_larm} @trigger
  - state{s=enter;p=14} @self
  - mountmodel{mode=[
      - move{front=<skill.var.meg:front>;side=0} ?!variableEquals{var=caster.flooded;val=true}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_exit_driver} @trigger ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:sneak;value=>0}
      - setvar{var=caster.honk;val=false;type=STRING} @self ?variableEquals{var=skill.meg:jump;value=0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_blinker_left} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:side;value=>0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_blinker_right} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:side;value=<0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_blinker_reset} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:side;value=-0.1to0.1}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_honk} @self ?variableEquals{var=skill.meg:jump;value=1}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_forward_set} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:front;value=>0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_reverse_set} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:front;value=<0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_direction_stop} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:front;value=0}
    ]} @trigger
  
# HIDE DRIVER #
VEHICLE_CAR_hide_driver:
  Skills:
  - potion{type=DAMAGE_RESISTANCE;l=4;d=10;p=false;i=false} @self
  - potion{type=INVISIBILITY;l=4;d=10;p=false;i=false} @self

  Skills:
  - stopsound{s=littleroom_vehicle_pack:vehicle.car_accelerate_idle_60_tick;v=1;sc=HOSTILE} @pir{r=4}
  - setvar{var=caster.engine;val=stopped;type=STRING} @self

  Skills:

  - mountmodel{mode=[
      - move{front=<skill.var.meg:front>;side=0} ?!variableEquals{var=caster.flooded;val=true}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_exit_driver} @trigger ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:sneak;value=>0}
      - setvar{var=caster.honk;val=false;type=STRING} @self ?variableEquals{var=skill.meg:jump;value=0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_blinker_left} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:side;value=>0}

      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_forward_set} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:front;value=>0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_reverse_set} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:front;value=<0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_direction_stop} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:front;value=0}
    ]} @trigger

VEHICLE_BIKE_enter:
  Cooldown: 1
  TriggerConditions:
  - holding{m=VEHICLE_PAINT_*} false
  - holding{m=VEHICLE_WRENCH} false
  - holding{i=stick} false
  - fieldofview{angle=180;r=90} orElseCast VEHICLE_BIKE_enter_right
  Conditions:
  - (varequals{var=caster.bike_toppled;val=front} || varequals{var=caster.bike_toppled;val=side}) castinstead VEHICLE_BIKE_pickup
  - varequals{var=caster.flooded;val=true} false
  - modelhasdriver false
  Skills:
  - sudoskill{s=VEHICLE_BIKE_hide_driver;cat=true} @trigger
  - sound{s=littleroom_vehicle_pack:vehicle.bike_start;v=1;sc=HOSTILE;delay=5} @self
  - setvar{var=caster.engine;val=started;type=STRING;delay=20} @self
  - partvis{p=head_light;v=true} @self
  - partvis{p=root_driver;child=true;v=true;em=true} @self
  - modelplayerskin{p=driver_body,driver_head,driver_rleg,driver_lleg,driver_rarm,driver_larm} @trigger
  - state{s=enter;p=14} @self
  - mountmodel{mode=[
      - move{front=<skill.var.meg:front>;side=0} ?!variableEquals{var=caster.flooded;val=true}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_BIKE_exit} @trigger ?variableEquals{var=skill.meg:sneak;value=1}
      - setvar{var=caster.honk;val=false;type=STRING} @self ?variableEquals{var=skill.meg:jump;value=0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_BIKE_lean_left} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:side;value=>0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_BIKE_lean_right} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:side;value=<0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_BIKE_lean_reset} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:side;value=-0.1to0.1}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_BIKE_wheelie} @self ?variableEquals{var=skill.meg:jump;value=1}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_BIKE_forward_set} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:front;value=>0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_BIKE_reverse_set} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:front;value=<0}

# ENTER VEHICLE LEFT SIDE #
VEHICLE_CAR_POLICE_enter_driver:
  Cooldown: 1
  TriggerConditions:
  - fieldofview{angle=90;r=90}
  Conditions:
  - varequals{var=caster.flooded;val=true} false
  - modelhasdriver false
  Skills:
  - setvar{var=caster.alarm_setoff;val=false;type=STRING} @self
  - sound{s=littleroom_vehicle_pack:vehicle.door_shut;v=1;p=<random.float.-0.8to1.1>;sc=HOSTILE;delay=8} @self
  - sound{s=littleroom_vehicle_pack:vehicle.car_start;v=1;sc=HOSTILE;delay=5} @self
  - setvar{var=caster.engine;val=started;type=STRING;delay=20} @self
  - partvis{p=head_light;v=true} @self
  - partvis{p=root_driver;child=true;v=true;em=true} @self
  - modelplayerskin{p=driver_body,driver_head,driver_rleg,driver_lleg,driver_rarm,driver_larm} @trigger
  - state{s=enter;p=14} @self
  - mountmodel{mode=[
      - move{front=<skill.var.meg:front>;side=0} ?!variableEquals{var=caster.flooded;val=true}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_POLICE_exit_driver} @trigger ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:sneak;value=>0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_POLICE_blinker_left} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:side;value=>0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_POLICE_blinker_right} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:side;value=<0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_POLICE_blinker_reset} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:side;value=-0.1to0.1}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_POLICE_toggle_siren} @self ?variableEquals{var=skill.meg:jump;value=1}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_POLICE_forward_set} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:front;value=>0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_POLICE_reverse_set} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:front;value=<0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_POLICE_direction_stop} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:front;value=0}
    ]} @trigger
  
# HIDE DRIVER #
VEHICLE_CAR_POLICE_hide_driver:
  Skills:
  - potion{type=DAMAGE_RESISTANCE;l=4;d=10;p=false;i=false} @self
  - potion{type=INVISIBILITY;l=4;d=10;p=false;i=false} @self
  - hide{d=20} @Server

  Conditions:
  - varequals{var=caster.driverexit;val=true} false
  Skills:
  - stopsound{s=littleroom_vehicle_pack:vehicle.car_accelerate_idle_60_tick;v=1;sc=HOSTILE} @pir{r=4}

# ENTER VEHICLE LEFT SIDE #
VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_enter_driver:
  Cooldown: 1
  TriggerConditions:
  - fieldofview{angle=90;r=90}
  Conditions:
  - varequals{var=caster.flooded;val=true} false
  - modelhasdriver false
  Skills:
  - setvar{var=caster.alarm_setoff;val=false;type=STRING} @self
  - sound{s=littleroom_vehicle_pack:vehicle.door_shut;v=1;p=<random.float.-0.8to1.1>;sc=HOSTILE;delay=8} @self
  - sound{s=littleroom_vehicle_pack:vehicle.car_start;v=1;sc=HOSTILE;delay=5} @self
  - setvar{var=caster.engine;val=started;type=STRING;delay=20} @self
  - partvis{p=head_light;v=true} @self
  - partvis{p=root_driver;child=true;v=true;em=true} @self
  - modelplayerskin{p=driver_body,driver_head,driver_rleg,driver_lleg,driver_rarm,driver_larm} @trigger
  - state{s=enter;p=14} @self
  - mountmodel{mode=[
      - move{front=<skill.var.meg:front>;side=0} ?!variableEquals{var=caster.flooded;val=true}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_exit_driver} @trigger ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:sneak;value=>0}
      - setvar{var=caster.honk;val=false;type=STRING} @self ?variableEquals{var=skill.meg:jump;value=0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_blinker_left} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:side;value=>0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_blinker_right} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:side;value=<0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_blinker_reset} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:side;value=-0.1to0.1}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_honk} @self ?variableEquals{var=skill.meg:jump;value=1}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_forward_set} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:front;value=>0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_reverse_set} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:front;value=<0}
      - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_direction_stop} @self ?variableInRange{var=skill.meg:front;value=0}
    ]} @trigger
  
# HIDE DRIVER #
VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_hide_driver:
  Skills:
  - potion{type=DAMAGE_RESISTANCE;l=4;d=10;p=false;i=false} @self
  - potion{type=INVISIBILITY;l=4;d=10;p=false;i=false} @self
  - hide{d=20} @Server
  
# EXIT DRIVER #
VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_exit_driver:
  Cooldown: 1
  Conditions:
  - varequals{var=caster.driverexit;val=true} false
  Skills:
  - stopsound{s=littleroom_vehicle_pack:vehicle.car_accelerate_idle_60_tick;v=1;sc=HOSTILE} @pir{r=4}
  - setvar{var=caster.engine;val=stopped;type=STRING} @self
  - sound{s=littleroom_vehicle_pack:vehicle.door_shut;v=1;p=<random.float.-0.8to1.1>;sc=HOSTILE;delay=10} @self
  - setvar{var=caster.driverexit;val="true";type=STRING;d=10} @self
  - partvis{p=root_driver;child=true;em=true;delay=3} @self
  - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_direction_stop} @self
  - state{s=exit;p=14} @self
  - sudoskill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_show_driver} @trigger
  - skill{s=VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_exit_lights_time_out;delay=80} @self
  - delay 3
  - dismountmodel @trigger

# UNHIDE DRIVER #
VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_show_driver:
  Skills:
  - potionclear{type=INVISIBILITY;repeat=4;repeati=1;delay=3} @self
  - showEntity{delay=3} @Server
  
# LIGHTS TIME OUT #
VEHICLE_CAR_TAXI_exit_lights_time_out:

  - modelhasdriver false
  Skills:
  - partvis{p=head_light;v=false} @self
  - partvis{p=brake_light;v=false} @self

jet_ski_actionbar:
  TargetConditions:
  - ModelHasDriver true
  Skills:
  - actionmessage{m="&7Engine speed of &e<caster.var.jet_ski_speed>/3       &e<caster.var.jet_ski_fuel>/<caster.var.jet_ski_fuel_max> &6&l⛽"} @ModelDriver



jet_ski_speed_up:
  Conditions:
  - offgcd true
  TargetConditions:
  - variableInRange{var=target.jet_ski_speed;value=">3"} cancel
  Skills:
  - variableadd{var=target.jet_ski_speed;amount=1}
  - gcd 15

jet_ski_speed_up_max:
  Conditions:
  - offgcd true
  TargetConditions:
  - variableInRange{var=target.jet_ski_speed;value=">2"} true
  Skills:
  - setvariable{var=target.jet_ski_speed;value="1";type=INTEGER}
  - gcd 15

jet_ski_speed_1:
  TargetConditions:
  - variableEquals{var=target.jet_ski_speed;value="2"} true
  - inblock{m=water}
  - velocity{v=>0.35} true
  - ModelHasDriver true
  - variableInRange{var=target.jet_ski_fuel;value="<2"} cancel
  Skills:
  - lunge{v=0.55} @self
  - variablesubtract{var=target.jet_ski_fuel;amount=2}

jet_ski_speed_2:
  TargetConditions:
  - variableEquals{var=target.jet_ski_speed;value="3"} true
  - inblock{m=water}
  - velocity{v=>0.41} true
  - ModelHasDriver true
  - variableInRange{var=target.jet_ski_fuel;value="<2"} cancel
  Skills:
  - lunge{v=0.65} @self
  - variablesubtract{var=target.jet_ski_fuel;amount=4}


jet_ski_item:
  TargetConditions:
  - DrivingModel true
  Skills:
  - Aura{auraName=jet_ski_fuel;onStart=jet_ski_item_start;duration=20;onEnd=jet_ski_item_end;rd=true}

jet_ski_item_start:
  Skills:
  - giveitem{i=jet_ski_speed}

jet_ski_item_end:
  Skills:
  - takeitem{i=jet_ski_speed;a=3}



jet_ski_fuel_regen:
  TargetConditions:
  - variableInRange{var=target.jet_ski_fuel;value=">74"} cancel
  - velocity{v=<0.18} true
  Skills:
  - variableadd{var=target.jet_ski_fuel;amount=1}

jet_ski_no_fuel:
  TargetConditions:
  - variableInRange{var=target.jet_ski_fuel;value="<5"} true
  Skills:
  - Aura{auraName=jet_ski_fuel;onStart=jet_ski_speed_clear;duration=20;onEnd=speed_effect;rd=true}

jet_ski_speed_clear:
  Skills:
  - potionclear{} @self
  - message{m="&c&l✕ &r&cYou don't have enough &lFuel &r&cfor a gear higher than 1 &c&l✕"} @ModelDriver
  - message{m="&7keep stopped to regenerate fuel"} @ModelDriver
  - skill{s=speed_clear_sound} @modeldriver

  Conditions:
  - velocity{v=>0.15} true
  Skills:
  - sound{s=ambient.underwater.enter;v=0.35;p=0.65}

  Despawn: False

#################
  Options:
    AlwaysShowName: false
    Silent: true
    PreventOtherDrops: true

    MaxCombatDistance: 40

  DamageModifiers:
  - SUFFOCATION 0.0
  AIGoalSelectors:
  - 0 clear
  - 1 lookatplayers
  - 2 randomstroll

  - 0 clear

  - sound{s=entity.wolf.hurt;p=1.2} @self ~onDamaged
  - sound{s=entity.wolf.death} @self ~onDeath
  - skill{s=VS_PUG_SIT;sync=true} @Trigger ~onInteract
  - randomskill{skills=VS_PUG_BARK,VS_PUG_CURIOUS} @self ~onTimer:600 0.5

###############################################
##     Developed by Elo106 and Pashjn        ##
##VOXEL SPAWNS https://discord.gg/BypTbqTk   ##
###############################################

VS_PUG_SIT:
  Cooldown: 1
  TargetConditions:
  - holding{m=BONE} castinstead VS_PUG_PLAY
  - holding{m=LEAD} castinstead VS_PUG_SCRATCH
  Conditions:
  - hastag{t=sitting} castinstead VS_PUG_STAND
  - offgcd
  Skills:
  - gcd{ticks=21} @self
  - potion{type=SLOW;d=100000;l=42;p=false;force=true} @self
  - addtag{t=sitting} @self
  - defaultstate{t=IDLE;s=sit_idle} @self
  - state{s=sitdown} @self

VS_PUG_STAND:
  Conditions:
  - offgcd
  Skills:
  - gcd{ticks=21} @self
  - state{s=getup} @self
  - defaultstate{t=IDLE;s=idle} @self
  - potion{type=SLOW;d=1;l=43;p=false;force=true} @self
  - removetag{t=sitting} @self

VS_PUG_PLAY:
  Conditions:
  - offgcd
  - hastag{t=sitting} false
  Skills:
  - CancelEvent
  - gcd{ticks=85} @self
  - potion{type=SLOW;d=85;l=42;p=false;force=true} @self
  - state{s=playwithme} @self
  - delay 20
  - sound{s=entity.wolf.pant;p=1.2} @self
  - delay 15
  - sound{s=entity.wolf.pant;p=1.5} @self
  - delay 20
  - sound{s=entity.wolf.pant;p=1.2} @self

VS_PUG_SCRATCH:
  Conditions:
  - offgcd
  Skills:
  - CancelEvent
  - gcd{ticks=120} @self
  - potion{type=SLOW;d=120;l=42;p=false;force=true} @self
  - state{s=ass_slide} @self

VS_PUG_BARK:
  Conditions:
  - offgcd
  - hastag{t=sitting} false
  Skills:
  - gcd{ticks=21} @self
  - potion{type=SLOW;d=21;l=42;p=false;force=true} @self
  - state{s=bark} @self
  - delay 5
  - sound{s=vs.vs_pug_bark;p=1.2} @self
  - delay 8
  - sound{s=vs.vs_pug_bark;p=1.2} @self

VS_PUG_CURIOUS:
  Conditions:
  - offgcd
  - hastag{t=sitting} false
  - playerwithin{d=3} true
  Skills:
  - gcd{ticks=81} @self
  - potion{type=SLOW;d=81;l=42;p=false;force=true} @self
  - state{s=lookylooky} @self

VS_PUG_BYE:
  Skills:
  - state{s=despawn} @self
  - delay 80
  - model{mid=voxelspawns_pug;r=true} @self
  - remove @self

  - randomstroll

  - clear
  - monsters
  - OtherFactionMonsters

CancelEvent:
  Conditions:
  - incombat true
  Skills:
  - CancelEvent @self

#baby_polar_bear
baby_polar_bear_scratch:
  Conditions:
  - incombat true
  - targetwithin{d=3} true
  Skills:
  - CancelEvent @self
  - setspeed{speed=0;type=WALKING} @self
  - state{model=baby_polar_bear;state=scratch} @self
  - delay 15
  - sound{s=entity.phantom.bite;p=1.5} @self
  - damage{a=10} @LivingInCone{a=90;r=3;targetowner=false}
  - delay 20
  - setspeed{speed=1.5;type=WALKING} @self
 
#baby_yeti 
baby_yeti_throw:
  Conditions:
  - incombat true
  - targetwithin{d=6} true
  Skills:
  - CancelEvent @self
  - setspeed{speed=0;type=WALKING} @self
  - state{model=baby_yeti;state=throw} @self
  - delay 14
  - sound{s=entity.snowball.throw;p=2} @self
  - damage{a=10;pi=true} @target
  - delay 16
  - setspeed{speed=1.5;type=WALKING} @self


#frost_ferret
frost_ferret_throw:
  Conditions:
  - incombat true
  - targetwithin{d=10} true
  Skills:
  - CancelEvent @self
  - setspeed{speed=0;type=WALKING} @self
  - state{model=frost_ferret;state=throw} @self
  - delay 15
  - sound{s=entity.skeleton.shoot;p=0.5} @self
  - damage{a=10;pi=true} @target
  - delay 3

#TICK VFX
xiddri_tick:
    Conditions:
        - hastag{t=flying} castInstead xiddri_thunder_prompt
        - hastag{t=roar_1st} cast xiddri_inrock_1st_roar_tick
        - hastag{t=roar_2nd} cast xiddri_inrock_2nd_roar_tick

xiddri_thunder_prompt:
    Conditions:
        - incombat true
        - hastag{t=skill_lock} false 
        - hastag{t=flying} true 
    Skills:
        - totem{ch=1;onStart=xiddri_thunder_strike;int=1;hR=3;md=1} @RLNTE{a=3;r=20;s=8;minr=8} 
        - signal{s=LIGHTNING} @MobsInRadius{r=20;t=xiddri_rock_onground}
        - delay 24
        - effect:sound{s=entity.generic.explode;v=8;p=1.5} @origin

xiddri_thunder_strike:
    Skills:

text:
categories:
  Garden furniture: #菜单的ID 随意填写
    enabled: true 
    skip_if_already: false
    icon: "garden:garden_arch" #IA菜单页面分类显示的图标 填写物品信息或者以你的 命名空间:模型名 来设定
    name: Garden #中文需要加引号 '' ""
    items: #填写物品，需要填写 命名空间:物品名
      - 'garden:garden_arch'
      - 'garden:garden_bush'
      - 'garden:garden_tree'
      - 'garden:flowering_garden_tree'
      - 'garden:garden_fence'
      - 'garden:garden_pillar'
      - 'garden:ruined_garden_pillar'
      - 'garden:garden_stand'
      - 'garden:garden_bench'
      - 'garden:garden_lamppost'
      - 'garden:garden_trellis'
      - 'garden:garden_fountain'     
      - 'garden:garden_chair'
      - 'garden:garden_trash_bin'
      - 'garden:garden_table'
      - 'garden:garden_tools'
      - 'garden:watering_can'
      - 'garden:garden_cart'

      

info:
  namespace: garden #命名空间名字，此处数值必须对应文件夹里的名字，在resourcepack/assets文件夹里的文件就是命名空间，命名空间名字可随意命名
items:
  garden_arch:  #物品的ID，随意配置，例如你想做一个苹果树那可以叫 apple_tree，不可以有大写
    display_name: Garden Arch #随便填名字，中文需要加双引号
    resource:
      material: LEATHER_HORSE_ARMOR #原版物品
      generate: false #是否自动生成模型，用于2D物品16*16贴图自动生成模型，如有模型填false
      model_path: item/1 #模型文件，模型放在resourcepack/assets/namespac/models 可在此创建文件夹，则此处路径填写为   文件夹名/模型名 例如 test/test
    behaviours:
      furniture:

text:
# If you want to know more about bank guis: https://github.com/Pulsih/BankPlus/wiki/Bank-Config
Title: "&f"
Lines: 5
Update-Delay: 10
Filler:
  Enabled: false
  Material: "WHITE_STAINED_GLASS_PANE"
  Glowing: false

# If the settings are not specified and the multiple
# bank module is enabled, the plugin will use the
# default item format to show the bank.
Settings:
  # The permission needed to open the bank, remove
  # or put "" to make it accessible to everyone.
  Permission: "bankplus.use"

  # Enable this setting to allow players to receive
  # interest even if they cannot access the
  # bank (useful with servers that access the bank
  # only from the force command cmd)
  Give-Interest-If-Not-Available: false

  # This is the item that will be showed up in the
  # banks-gui if the multiple-banks module is enabled.
  #
  # You can also use heads and placeholders.
  BanksGuiItem:
    # The item showed in the banks gui
    # if this bank is available.
    Available:
      Material: "CHEST"
      Displayname: "&a&lBANK"
      Lore:
        - "&aYour main bank :)"
        - ""
        - "&7Bank capacity: &a%bankplus_capacity{bank}%"
        - "&7Bank level: &a%bankplus_level{bank}%"
        - "&7Bank money: &a%bankplus_balance_formatted{bank}%"
        - ""
        - "&aAvailable: &2YES"
      Glowing: false

    # The item showed in the banks gui
    # if this bank is unavailable.
    Unavailable:
      Material: "CHEST"
      Displayname: "&a&lBANK"
      Lore:
        - "&aYour main bank :)"
        - ""
        - "&7Bank capacity: &a%bankplus_capacity{bank}%"
        - "&7Bank level: &a%bankplus_level{bank}%"
        - "&7Bank money: &a%bankplus_balance_formatted{bank}%"
        - ""
        - "&aAvailable: &cNO"
        - "&aNeeded permission: &bbankplus.use"
      Glowing: false

# These are the bank levels, you can upgrade a bank
# by running the command /bank upgrade <bank> or by
# using the action in the gui "Upgrade".
#
# If the levels section isn't specified, the bank will
# have no upgrades and will use the default values set
# in the config.yml
Levels:
  # This must be a number an indicates the bank level.
  1: # 1 Is the default level, it can't be lower than 1.
    Capacity: "50000"
    Interest: "5%"
    Offline-Interest: "2%"
  2:
    # The cost that a player will need to
    # pay to upgrade the bank to level 2.
    Cost: "5000"

    # You can put "" or remove this to not require any item.
    # Specify what items a player needs to have to upgrade to the level 2.
    # Format: ITEM_NAME-AMOUNT
    # You can also use "," to specify more items, check the 3* upgrade for an example.
    Required-Items: "DIAMOND-2"

    # Put false or remove this to not remove any item.
    # Choose if removing or not the required items in the player inventory.
    Remove-Required-Items: true

    # If the capacity is not specified, the bank will
    # have the default capacity set in the config.yml
    Capacity: "100000"

    # If the interest is not specified, the bank will
    # use the default interest rate from the config.yml
    Interest: "10%"

    # This offline interest will only work if the 'Different-Offline-Rate'
    # section is enabled in the config.yml, otherwise it will use the normal interest.
    Offline-Interest: "5%"

    # The max amount that a player can receive in interest.
    # Max-Interest-Amount: 10000
  3:
    Cost: "10000"
    Required-Items: "DIAMOND-4,EMERALD-2"
    Remove-Required-Items: true
    Capacity: "200000"
    Interest: "20%"
    Offline-Interest: "10%"

Items:
  # You can add as many items as you want.
  WithdrawButton1:
    Material: "STICK"
    CustomModelData: 8191035
    Amount: 1
    Displayname: "&8&l[&a&lWITHDRAW&8&l] &f500$"
    Slot: 12
    # You can edit the custom
    # model data of an item.
    #
    # Working only on 1.14.4+
    #CustomModelData: 10
    Lore:
      - ""
      - "&7Withdraw &a500$ &7from your bank."
      - "&8Taxes with 500$: &f%bankplus_calculate_withdraw_taxes_number_500%"
      - ""
    Glowing: false
    Actions:
      # Action list:
      # * The amount can be a number, a % or "CUSTOM"
      # - [WITHDRAW] <amount>
      # - [DEPOSIT] <amount>
      # - [UPGRADE] ( As the name says, is a shortcut for the command /bank upgrade )
      # - [PLAYER] <chat> ( Force the player to chat, it can also be a command. )
      # - [CONSOLE] <command> ( Without "/"! | Execute a console command. )
      # - [MESSAGE] <message> ( Send a message to the player. )
      - "[WITHDRAW] 500"

  WithdrawButton2:
    Material: "STICK"
    CustomModelData: 8191035
    Amount: 1
    Displayname: "&8&l[&a&lWITHDRAW&8&l] &f25%"
    Slot: 13
    Lore:
      - ""
      - "&7Withdraw &a25% &7of the money from your bank."
      - "&8Taxes with 25%: &f%bankplus_calculate_withdraw_taxes_percentage_25%"
      - ""
    Glowing: false
    Actions:
      - "[WITHDRAW] 25%"

  WithdrawButton3:
    Material: "STICK"
    CustomModelData: 8191035
    Amount: 1
    Displayname: "&8&l[&a&lWITHDRAW&8&l] &f50%"
    Slot: 14
    Lore:
      - ""
      - "&7Withdraw &a50% &7of the money from your bank."
      - "&8Taxes with 50%: &f%bankplus_calculate_withdraw_taxes_percentage_50%"
      - ""
    Glowing: false
    Actions:
      - "[WITHDRAW] 50%"

  WithdrawButton4:
    Material: "STICK"
    CustomModelData: 8191035
    Amount: 1
    Slot: 15
    Displayname: "&8&l[&a&lWITHDRAW&8&l] &fALL"
    Lore:
      - ""
      - "&7Withdraw &aall &7your money from your bank."
      - "&8Taxes with all money: &f%bankplus_calculate_withdraw_taxes_percentage_100%"
      - ""
    Glowing: false
    Actions:
      - "[WITHDRAW] 100%"

  WithdrawButton5:
    Material: "STICK"
    CustomModelData: 8191035
    Amount: 1
    Slot: 16
    Displayname: "&8&l[&a&lWITHDRAW&8&l] &fCUSTOM"
    Lore:
      - ""
      - "&7Withdraw a &acustom &7amount from your bank &a&nthrough chat&7."
      - ""
    Glowing: false
    Actions:
      - "[WITHDRAW] CUSTOM"

  # Personal-Info:
  #   Material: "HEAD-%PLAYER%"
  #   Displayname: "&8&l* &a&lPERSONAL"
  #   Slot: 14
  #   Lore:
  #     - ""
  #     - "&7Account Name: &a%player_name%"
  #     - "&7Balance: &a%bankplus_balance_formatted%"
  #     - "&7Capacity: &a%bankplus_capacity_formatted%"
  #     - ""
  #     - "&7Wait &a%bankplus_interest_cooldown% &7to get interest!"
  #     - "&7Expected money from the next interest: &a%bankplus_next_interest_formatted%"
  #     - "&7Interest rate: &a%bankplus_interest_rate%%"
  #     - "&7Offline interest rate: &a%bankplus_offline_interest_rate%%"
  #     - ""
  #     - "&7&o(( %bankplus_withdraw_taxes% Withdraw Taxes. %bankplus_deposit_taxes% Deposit Taxes. ))"
  #   Glowing: false

  How-Does-It-Work:
    Material: "STICK"
    CustomModelData: 8191035
    Displayname: "&8&l* &a&lHOW DOES IT WORK?"
    Slot: 17
    Lore:
      - ""
      - "&7This is a bank, you can &adeposit &7all your"
      - "&7money here to keep them &asafe&7, your money"
      - "&7kept in the bank will &aincrease &7thanks to"
      - "&7the &a&ninterest&7, which gives you a percentage of"
      - "&7your money in the &abank&7!"
      - ""
    Glowing: false

  Upgrade:
    Material: "STICK"
    CustomModelData: 8191035
    Amount: 1
    Slot: 35
    Displayname: "&8&l[&a&lUPGRADE &9&lBANK&8&l]"
    Lore:
      Default:
        - ""
        - "&7Upgrade your bank to the next level!"
        - ""
        - "&7Level: &7%bankplus_level% &8-> &a%bankplus_next_level%"
        - "&7Upgrade Cost: &a%bankplus_next_level_cost%"
        - "&7Required Items: &b%bankplus_next_level_required_items%"
        - ""
        - "&bNew statistics:"
        - " &8* &aCapacity: &f%bankplus_next_level_capacity%"
        - " &8* &aInterest: &f%bankplus_next_level_interest_rate%"
        - " &8* &aOffline interest: &f%bankplus_next_level_offline_interest_rate%"
        - ""
      3:
        - ""
        - "&2Your bank is maxed out!"
        - ""
        - "&bStatistics:"
        - " &8* &aLevel: &b%bankplus_level%"
        - " &8* &aCapacity: &f%bankplus_capacity%"
        - " &8* &aInterest: &f%bankplus_interest_rate%"
        - " &8* &aOffline interest: &f%bankplus_offline_interest_rate%"
        - ""
    Glowing: false
    Actions:
      - "[UPGRADE]"

  DepositButton1:
    Material: "STICK"
    CustomModelData: 8191035
    Amount: 1
    Slot: 30
    Displayname: "&8&l[&9&lDEPOSIT&8&l] &f500$"
    Lore:
      - ""
      - "&7Deposit &a500$ &7in your bank."
      - "&8Taxes with 500$: &f%bankplus_calculate_deposit_taxes_number_500%"
      - ""
    Glowing: false
    Actions:
      - "[DEPOSIT] 500"

  DepositButton2:
    Material: "STICK"
    CustomModelData: 8191035
    Amount: 1
    Slot: 31
    Displayname: "&8&l[&9&lDEPOSIT&8&l] &f25%"
    Lore:
      - ""
      - "&7Deposit &a25% &7of the money in your bank."
      - "&8Taxes with 25%: &f%bankplus_calculate_deposit_taxes_percentage_25%"
      - ""
    Glowing: false
    Actions:
      - "[DEPOSIT] 25%"

  DepositButton3:
    Material: "STICK"
    CustomModelData: 8191035
    Amount: 1
    Slot: 32
    Displayname: "&8&l[&9&lDEPOSIT&8&l] &f50%"
    Lore:
      - ""
      - "&7Deposit &a50% &7of the money in your bank."
      - "&8Taxes with 50%: &f%bankplus_calculate_deposit_taxes_percentage_25%"
      - ""
    Glowing: false
    Actions:
      - "[DEPOSIT] 50%"

  DepositButton4:
    Material: "STICK"
    CustomModelData: 8191035
    Amount: 1
    Slot: 33
    Displayname: "&8&l[&9&lDEPOSIT&8&l] &fALL"
    Lore:
      - ""
      - "&7Deposit &aall &7your the in your bank."
      - "&8Taxes with all money: &f%bankplus_calculate_deposit_taxes_percentage_100%"
      - ""
    Glowing: false
    Actions:
      - "[DEPOSIT] 100%"

    Displayname: "&8&l[&9&lDEPOSIT&8&l] &fCUSTOM"

Title: "&f<glyph:medieval_bank_offset><glyph:medieval_bank_gui>"
Lines: 5
Update-Delay: 10
Filler:
  Enabled: false
  Material: "WHITE_STAINED_GLASS_PANE"
  Glowing: false

# If the settings are not specified and the multiple
# bank module is enabled, the plugin will use the
# default item format to show the bank.
Settings:
  # The permission needed to open the bank, remove
  # or put "" to make it accessible to everyone.
  Permission: "bankplus.use"

  # Enable this setting to allow players to receive
  # interest even if they cannot access the
  # bank (useful with servers that access the bank
  # only from the force command cmd)
  Give-Interest-If-Not-Available: false

  # This is the item that will be showed up in the
  # banks-gui if the multiple-banks module is enabled.
  #
  # You can also use heads and placeholders.
  BanksGuiItem:
    # The item showed in the banks gui
    # if this bank is available.
    Available:
      Material: "CHEST"
      Displayname: "&a&lBANK"
      Lore:
        - "&aYour main bank :)"
        - ""
        - "&7Bank capacity: &a%bankplus_capacity{bank}%"
        - "&7Bank level: &a%bankplus_level{bank}%"
        - "&7Bank money: &a%bankplus_balance_formatted{bank}%"
        - ""
        - "&aAvailable: &2YES"
      Glowing: false

    # The item showed in the banks gui
    # if this bank is unavailable.
    Unavailable:
      Material: "CHEST"
      Displayname: "&a&lBANK"
      Lore:
        - "&aYour main bank :)"
        - ""
        - "&7Bank capacity: &a%bankplus_capacity{bank}%"
        - "&7Bank level: &a%bankplus_level{bank}%"
        - "&7Bank money: &a%bankplus_balance_formatted{bank}%"
        - ""
        - "&aAvailable: &cNO"
        - "&aNeeded permission: &bbankplus.use"
      Glowing: false

# These are the bank levels, you can upgrade a bank
# by running the command /bank upgrade <bank> or by
# using the action in the gui "Upgrade".
#
# If the levels section isn't specified, the bank will
# have no upgrades and will use the default values set
# in the config.yml
Levels:
  # This must be a number an indicates the bank level.
  1: # 1 Is the default level, it can't be lower than 1.
    Capacity: "50000"
    Interest: "5%"
    Offline-Interest: "2%"
  2:
    # The cost that a player will need to
    # pay to upgrade the bank to level 2.
    Cost: "5000"

    # You can put "" or remove this to not require any item.
    # Specify what items a player needs to have to upgrade to the level 2.
    # Format: ITEM_NAME-AMOUNT
    # You can also use "," to specify more items, check the 3* upgrade for an example.
    Required-Items: "DIAMOND-2"

    # Put false or remove this to not remove any item.
    # Choose if removing or not the required items in the player inventory.
    Remove-Required-Items: true

    # If the capacity is not specified, the bank will
    # have the default capacity set in the config.yml
    Capacity: "100000"

    # If the interest is not specified, the bank will
    # use the default interest rate from the config.yml
    Interest: "10%"

    # This offline interest will only work if the 'Different-Offline-Rate'
    # section is enabled in the config.yml, otherwise it will use the normal interest.
    Offline-Interest: "5%"

    # The max amount that a player can receive in interest.
    # Max-Interest-Amount: 10000
  3:
    Cost: "10000"
    Required-Items: "DIAMOND-4,EMERALD-2"
    Remove-Required-Items: true
    Capacity: "200000"
    Interest: "20%"
    Offline-Interest: "10%"

Items:
  # You can add as many items as you want.
  WithdrawButton1:
    Material: "STICK"
    CustomModelData: 8191035
    Amount: 1
    Displayname: "&8&l[&a&lWITHDRAW&8&l] &f500$"
    Slot: 12
    # You can edit the custom
    # model data of an item.
    #
    # Working only on 1.14.4+
    #CustomModelData: 10
    Lore:
      - ""
      - "&7Withdraw &a500$ &7from your bank."
      - "&8Taxes with 500$: &f%bankplus_calculate_withdraw_taxes_number_500%"
      - ""
    Glowing: false
    Actions:
      # Action list:
      # * The amount can be a number, a % or "CUSTOM"
      # - [WITHDRAW] <amount>
      # - [DEPOSIT] <amount>
      # - [UPGRADE] ( As the name says, is a shortcut for the command /bank upgrade )
      # - [PLAYER] <chat> ( Force the player to chat, it can also be a command. )
      # - [CONSOLE] <command> ( Without "/"! | Execute a console command. )
      # - [MESSAGE] <message> ( Send a message to the player. )
      - "[WITHDRAW] 500"

  WithdrawButton2:
    Material: "STICK"
    CustomModelData: 8191035
    Amount: 1
    Displayname: "&8&l[&a&lWITHDRAW&8&l] &f25%"
    Slot: 13
    Lore:
      - ""
      - "&7Withdraw &a25% &7of the money from your bank."
      - "&8Taxes with 25%: &f%bankplus_calculate_withdraw_taxes_percentage_25%"
      - ""
    Glowing: false
    Actions:
      - "[WITHDRAW] 25%"

  WithdrawButton3:
    Material: "STICK"
    CustomModelData: 8191035
    Amount: 1
    Displayname: "&8&l[&a&lWITHDRAW&8&l] &f50%"
    Slot: 14
    Lore:
      - ""
      - "&7Withdraw &a50% &7of the money from your bank."
      - "&8Taxes with 50%: &f%bankplus_calculate_withdraw_taxes_percentage_50%"
      - ""
    Glowing: false
    Actions:
      - "[WITHDRAW] 50%"

  WithdrawButton4:
    Material: "STICK"
    CustomModelData: 8191035
    Amount: 1
    Slot: 15
    Displayname: "&8&l[&a&lWITHDRAW&8&l] &fALL"
    Lore:
      - ""
      - "&7Withdraw &aall &7your money from your bank."
      - "&8Taxes with all money: &f%bankplus_calculate_withdraw_taxes_percentage_100%"
      - ""
    Glowing: false
    Actions:
      - "[WITHDRAW] 100%"

  WithdrawButton5:
    Material: "STICK"
    CustomModelData: 8191035
    Amount: 1
    Slot: 16
    Displayname: "&8&l[&a&lWITHDRAW&8&l] &fCUSTOM"
    Lore:
      - ""
      - "&7Withdraw a &acustom &7amount from your bank &a&nthrough chat&7."
      - ""
    Glowing: false
    Actions:
      - "[WITHDRAW] CUSTOM"

  # Personal-Info:
  #   Material: "HEAD-%PLAYER%"
  #   Displayname: "&8&l* &a&lPERSONAL"
  #   Slot: 14
  #   Lore:
  #     - ""
  #     - "&7Account Name: &a%player_name%"
  #     - "&7Balance: &a%bankplus_balance_formatted%"
  #     - "&7Capacity: &a%bankplus_capacity_formatted%"
  #     - ""
  #     - "&7Wait &a%bankplus_interest_cooldown% &7to get interest!"
  #     - "&7Expected money from the next interest: &a%bankplus_next_interest_formatted%"
  #     - "&7Interest rate: &a%bankplus_interest_rate%%"
  #     - "&7Offline interest rate: &a%bankplus_offline_interest_rate%%"
  #     - ""
  #     - "&7&o(( %bankplus_withdraw_taxes% Withdraw Taxes. %bankplus_deposit_taxes% Deposit Taxes. ))"
  #   Glowing: false

  How-Does-It-Work:
    Material: "STICK"
    CustomModelData: 8191035
    Displayname: "&8&l* &a&lHOW DOES IT WORK?"
    Slot: 17
    Lore:
      - ""
      - "&7This is a bank, you can &adeposit &7all your"
      - "&7money here to keep them &asafe&7, your money"
      - "&7kept in the bank will &aincrease &7thanks to"
      - "&7the &a&ninterest&7, which gives you a percentage of"
      - "&7your money in the &abank&7!"
      - ""
    Glowing: false

  Upgrade:
    Material: "STICK"
    CustomModelData: 8191035
    Amount: 1
    Slot: 35
    Displayname: "&8&l[&a&lUPGRADE &9&lBANK&8&l]"
    Lore:
      Default:
        - ""
        - "&7Upgrade your bank to the next level!"
        - ""
        - "&7Level: &7%bankplus_level% &8-> &a%bankplus_next_level%"
        - "&7Upgrade Cost: &a%bankplus_next_level_cost%"
        - "&7Required Items: &b%bankplus_next_level_required_items%"
        - ""
        - "&bNew statistics:"
        - " &8* &aCapacity: &f%bankplus_next_level_capacity%"
        - " &8* &aInterest: &f%bankplus_next_level_interest_rate%"
        - " &8* &aOffline interest: &f%bankplus_next_level_offline_interest_rate%"
        - ""
      3:
        - ""
        - "&2Your bank is maxed out!"
        - ""
        - "&bStatistics:"
        - " &8* &aLevel: &b%bankplus_level%"
        - " &8* &aCapacity: &f%bankplus_capacity%"
        - " &8* &aInterest: &f%bankplus_interest_rate%"
        - " &8* &aOffline interest: &f%bankplus_offline_interest_rate%"
        - ""
    Glowing: false
    Actions:
      - "[UPGRADE]"

  DepositButton1:
    Material: "STICK"
    CustomModelData: 8191035
    Amount: 1
    Slot: 30
    Displayname: "&8&l[&9&lDEPOSIT&8&l] &f500$"
    Lore:
      - ""
      - "&7Deposit &a500$ &7in your bank."
      - "&8Taxes with 500$: &f%bankplus_calculate_deposit_taxes_number_500%"
      - ""
    Glowing: false
    Actions:
      - "[DEPOSIT] 500"

  DepositButton2:
    Material: "STICK"
    CustomModelData: 8191035
    Amount: 1

    Lore:
      - ""
      - "&7Deposit &a25% &7of the money in your bank."
      - "&8Taxes with 25%: &f%bankplus_calculate_deposit_taxes_percentage_25%"
      - ""
    Glowing: false

      - "[DEPOSIT] 25%"

  DepositButton3:
    Material: "STICK"
    CustomModelData: 8191035
    Amount: 1

    Lore:

      - "&7Deposit &a50% &7of the money in your bank."
      - "&8Taxes with 50%: &f%bankplus_calculate_deposit_taxes_percentage_25%"

  DepositButton4:

text:
# ======================================================
# Here you can create your own player quests interface.
#
# Never delete a %variable% unless you know what you're doing.
# %achieved% is replaced by the number of completed quests.
# %drawIn% is replaced by the time remaining before the next quests draw.
# ======================================================
player_interface:
  size: 45
  inventory_name: "&f"
  # disable the status of the quest if you want to handle it manually by placeholders
  disable_status: false
  # the 3 following lines will not be used if disable_status is set to true
  status: "&eStatus :"
  progress: "&eIN PROGRESS (&a%progress%&e/&c%required%&e)"
  achieved: "&aACHIEVED"
  # if you want to glow the item when the quest is achieved
  glowing_if_achieved: true
  complete_get_type: "&eClick to complete this quest !"
  player_head:
    enabled: true
    slot: 5
    item_name: "&bYour quests"
    item_description:
      - "&eCompleted quests : &b%achieved%&e/&63"
      - "&eNext draw in : &c%drawIn%"

  # ========================================================
  # Available types : FILL, PLAYER_COMMAND, CONSOLE_COMMAND
  # Placeholders : %player%
  # More info on Wiki.
  # ========================================================
  quests: # set the position of quests items
    1: 11
    2: 22
    3: 16
  items:
    0:
      type: CLOSE
      item:
        material: PAPER
        custom_model_data: 9926322
        name: "&cClose"
        lore: []
        slot: 9

text:
database:
  # Database backend type, can be set to mysql or sqlite
  type: sqlite
  # MySQL database host
  mySQLHost: localhost
  # MySQL connection port number
  mySQLPort: 3306
  # MySQL database name
  mySQLDatabase: db
  # MySQL database user
  mySQLUser: root
  # MySQL user's password
  mySQLPassword: ""
  # MySQL table names
  tableNames:
    players: "players"

# Types of economies which will be enabled and possible to use within shops.
# Supported economies:
#  - EXP (default Minecraft experience points)
#  - EXP_LEVELS (default Minecraft experience levels; integer prices recommended, prices are rounded down)
#  - VAULT (requires https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/vault.34315/)
#  - GEMS_ECONOMY (requires https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/gemseconomy.19655/)
#  - GRINGOTTS (requires https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/gringotts.42071/)
#  - MYSQL_TOKENS (requires https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/mysql-tokens.7535/)
#  - PLAYER_POINTS (requires https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/playerpoints.80745/)
#  - TOKEN_ENCHANT (requires https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/tokenenchant.2287/)
#  - TOKEN_MANAGER (requires https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/tokenmanager.8610/)
#  - VOTING_PLUGIN (requires https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/votingplugin.15358/)
#  - COINS_ENGINE (requires https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/coinsengine.84121/)
# First position will be the default economy for all shops.
economyTypes:
  - VAULT
# Name of the main GUI
shopMenuName: "&f"
# Size of the main GUI, valid values are 9, 18, 27, 36, 45 and 54
shopMenuSize: 45
# Choose an item to fill the empty slots of menu with
# shopMenuFillItem:
#   material: BLACK_STAINED_GLASS_PANE
#   name: " "
# Define whether selling all with middle mouse button is enabled
enableSellAll: true
# Define whether the buy GUI with option to select quantity is enabled
enableBuyGUI: true
# Define whether the sell GUI with option to select quantity is enabled
enableSellGUI: true
# Define whether sell all button in SellGUI is enabled (enableSellGUI has to be enabled too)
enableSellGUISellAll: true
# Define whether after closing/buying/selling the shop GUI should be opened again
returnToShop: true
# Define whether the quick buy/sell option should be enabled (amount selection gui will stay open until player closes it)
quickBuySell: false
# Define whether lines containing the %buy% placeholder should be hidden for unbuyable items
hideBuyPriceForUnbuyable: true
# Choose placeholder for the price when hideBuyPriceForUnbuyable is disabled
buyPriceForUnsellablePlaceholder: "-"
# Define whether lines containing the %sell% placeholder should be hidden for unsellable items
hideSellPriceForUnsellable: true
# Choose placeholder for the price when hideSellPriceForUnsellable is disabled
sellPriceForUnsellablePlaceholder: "-"
# Choose actions for mouse clicks inside shops
# Supported click types: all from ClickType enum (https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/spigot/org/bukkit/event/inventory/ClickType.html)
# Supported actions: BUY, SELL, SELL_ALL, NONE
clickActions:
  LEFT: BUY
  RIGHT: SELL
  SHIFT_RIGHT: SELL_ALL
  MIDDLE: SELL_ALL
# Maximum amount of enchantments players can add to an item, set to -1 for no limit
maxEnchantments: 3
# Choose whether players should be able to buy enchantments only 1 level higher than current (eg. player has sword with Sharpness 1, they could buy only Sharpness 2)
limitEnchantmentLevelDiff: false
# Define whether the amount selection double click bug fix should be enabled
enableAmountSelectionFix: true
# Define whether players should be able to use sell all option to sell all their items (allowAllSellAllStackSizes = true) or only amount multiplied by the original stack size of the shop item (allowAllSellAllStackSizes = false)
allowAllSellAllStackSizes: false
# Define whether all prices should be rounded up, down, to the nearest whole number or not rounded (valid values are UP, DOWN, NEAREST and NONE)
roundPrices: none
# Define whether main menu (/shop command) should be disabled. The only way to access shops will be to use /shop <id> when you disable it.
disableMainMenu: false
# Choose if different messages should be sent when someone buy/sell items for $0 (MSG_ITEM_BOUGHTFREE, MSG_ITEM_SOLDFREE, MSG_ITEM_SOLDALLFREE)
useDifferentMessagesForFreeItems: true
# Choose if item names should have first letters of their names capitalized, for instance nether brick would become Nether Brick
capitalizeItemNames: true
# Choose the type of price modifiers. (BOTH (permission modifiers have higher priority than command-ones), COMMAND, PERMISSION)
priceModifiersType: BOTH
# Choose if the gui shall be closed after using the Sell All feature
closeGuiAfterSellAll: false
# Choose if bulk buy/sell guis should be opened immediately after clicking an item (enableBuyGUI and enableSellGUI have to be enabled as well and players need the bulk buy/sell permissions)
openBulkGuiImmediately: false
# Choose if players who have the shop opened by console with /shop [player] should be able to access all shops regardless of permissions they have
sudoAllowAllShopsAccess: false
# Choose which items stack size should be capped at 16 inside the amount selection GUI so players can't buy eg. oversized ender pearl stacks
# Format is same as for regular items in shops yaml
itemStackSizeCappedAt:
  1:
    material: ENDER_PEARL
    size: 16
  2:
    material: SNOWBALL
    size: 16
  3:
    material: EGG
    size: 16
  4:
    material: BUCKET
    size: 1
# Choose what gamemodes will prevent players from accessing shops. Valid values: ADVENTURE, CREATIVE, SPECTATOR, SURVIVAL
disableShopsInGamemodes:
  - ADVENTURE
  - CREATIVE
  - SPECTATOR
# Choose in which worlds players won't be able to access the shop. Same list format as disableShopsInGamemodes
disableShopsInWorlds: [ ]

# Choose whether price modifiers should be displayed in percents instead of decimals (eg. 10% instead of 0.10), remember you will still have to use the decimal way in commands
displayPriceModifiersInPercents: true

# Choose whether the world-specific permission to access shops should be omitted when player has a shop opened with /shop [player] [shop name]
disableSudoWorldPermissionCheck: false

# Choose whether the shop-specific permission to access shops should be omitted when player has a shop opened with /shop [player] [shop name]
disableSudoShopPermissionCheck: false

# Choose whether the Enchantment Item Types are allowed to enchant items with unsafe enchants. (eg. Sticks with Sharpness 25)
disableUnsafeEnchantmentCheck: false

# Choose sounds for certain GUI actions. Full list is available at https://docs.brcdev.net/#/sounds
sounds:
  MAIN_MENU_OPEN: UI_BUTTON_CLICK
  SHOP_OPEN: UI_BUTTON_CLICK
  SHOP_SELECT_ITEM: UI_BUTTON_CLICK
  SHOP_SWITCH_PAGE: ITEM_BOOK_PAGE_TURN
  SELL_ITEM: ENTITY_EXPERIENCE_ORB_PICKUP
  SELL_ALL_ITEM: ENTITY_EXPERIENCE_ORB_PICKUP
  BUY_ITEM: ENTITY_EXPERIENCE_ORB_PICKUP

# Choose predefined settings for all items (will be overriden when set explicitly for an item in shops yaml)
defaultItemSettings:
  # Choose whether item meta (name, lore etc.) should be compared when players attempt to sell an item
  compareMeta: false
  # Choose whether item meta should be removed from an item when it's purchased by a player from the shop
  stripItemMeta: false
  # Choose whether item model should be compared when players attempt to sell an item
  compareModel: true
  # Choose whether item damage/durability should be compared when players attempt to sell an item
  compareDamage: false
  # Choose whether item NBT data should be compared when players attempt to sell an item
  compareNbt: false

# Format of item lores in shops, %buy% will be replaced with the buy price and %sell% with sell price
shopItemLoreFormat:
  # This lore will be applied to items
  item:
    - "&7Buy price: &c%buy%"
    - "&7Sell price: &a%sell%"
    - "&f  : Buy item"
    - "&f  : Sell all select"
    - "&f  +  : Sell all inventory"
  # This lore will be applied to items in the buy GUI (when enableBuyGUI is set to true)
  itemBuyGUI:
    - "&7Buy price: &c%buy%"
  # This lore will be applied to items in the sell GUI (when enableSellGUI is set to true)
  itemSellGUI:
    - "&7Sell price: &a%sell%"
  # This lore will be applied to the sell all button in the sell GUI (when enableSellGUI and enableSellGUISellAll are set to true)
  itemSellGUISellAll:
    - "&7Sell all for: &a%sell%"
  # This one to permissions
  permission:
    - "&7Buy price: &c%buy%"
  # And this one to enchantments
  enchantment:
    - "&7Buy price: &c%buy%"
  # And the last one to commands
  command:
    - "&7Buy price: &c%buy%"

# Logging settings
log:
  # Define whether transactions will be logged to the console/main server log
  toConsole: true
  # Define whether transactions will be logged to a separate log
  toFile: false
  # Date format of transactions (http://docs.oracle.com/javase/7/docs/api/java/text/SimpleDateFormat.html)
  formatDate: "yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss"
  # Log message for bought command
  formatBuyCommand: "%player% bought %amount% x %command% command for %price% from %shop% shop"
  # Log message for bought enchantment
  formatBuyEnchantment: "%player% bought %enchantment% enchantment for %price% from %shop% shop"
  # Log message for bought permission
  formatBuyPermission: "%player% bought %permission% permission for %price% from %shop% shop"
  # Log message for bought items
  formatBuy: "%player% bought %amount% x %item% for %price% from %shop% shop"
  # Log message for sold items
  formatSell: "%player% sold %amount% x %item% for %price% to %shop% shop"
  # Log message for sold all items
  formatSellAll: "%player% sold all %amount% x %item% for %price% to %shop% shop"

# Sell hand command settings
sellHand:
  # When set to true, players will be able to sell any quantity of the item (the price will be calculated from the base price)
  allowAllQuantities: true
  # When set to true, /sell hand will work same way as /sell handall does
  sellsAllItems: false
  # When set to true, free items (with sell price of $0) will be excluded from being sold using /sell hand and /sell handall
  excludeFreeItems: true
  # When set to true, items in armor slots will be excluded from being sold using /sell hand and /sell handall
  excludeArmorSlots: true
  # When set to true, items in the off-hand slot will be excluded from being sold using /sell hand and handall
  excludeOffHand: false

# Sell all command settings
sellAll:
  # When set to true, players will get a detailed summary with prices of each item stack sold
  detailedSummary: false
  # Choose if maximal sell price of an item across all shops should be chosen in sell all. Enabling this may affect sell command performance when having lots of shops/items
  findMaxSellPrice: true
  # When set to true, free items (with sell price of $0) will be excluded from being sold using /sell all
  excludeFreeItems: true
  # When set to true, items in armor slots will be excluded from being sold using /sell all
  excludeArmorSlots: true
  # When set to true, items in the off-hand slot will be excluded from being sold using /sell all
  excludeOffHand: false

# Format numbers within your messages using these options.
numberFormat:
  # Change the character used for separating decimals in figures which may not be whole numbers
  decimalSeparator: "."
  # Change the character using for separating commas in figures which are larger numbers
  groupingSeparator: ","
  # Specify the minimum number of digits shown for integer numbers
  minimumIntegerDigits: 1
  # Specify the maximum number of digits shown for integer numbers
  maximumIntegerDigits: 32
  # Specify the minimum number of decimal places shown for fractional numbers
  minimumFractionDigits: 0
  # Specify the maximum number of decimal places shown for fractional numbers
  maximumFractionDigits: 8
  # Specify whether you would like the ending decimal digits to be removed when not applicable. This will change $100.00 to $100
  hideFraction: true
  shortScale:
    # Specify whether you would like the number shown in messages to be converted in short-scale above a certain number. This will convert "1,000,000" to "1 million"
    enableShortScaleNumbering: false
    # Specify the limit at which short-scale number formatting will start from. Any number above this limit will be converted to short-scale number formatting
    shortScaleLimit: 1000000
    # Specify the maximum number of decimal place figures shown when showing the decimal part of the large, short-hand number. (Will truncate the figure to 2 d.p by default)
    shortHandDecimalLimit: 2
    # Specify the maximum number of digits shown in larger short-hand numbers. (Will truncate the figure to 32 digits by default)
    shortHandNumberLimit: 32

text:
PREFIX: '&aShop > &f'
LANG:
  CONSOLE: Console
MSG:
  AND: ' and '
  ERROR: Error occurred, please contact the server owner.
  INGAMEONLY: This command can be used only in the game.
  NOACCESS: You don't have access to do this.
  NOTLOADED: Shops haven't been loaded yet, please try again later.
  RELOADED: Configuration reloaded!
  USAGE:
    SUBCOMMAND: 'Invalid command usage. Correct usage: %usage%'
  CMD:
    SHOP:
      ADDMODIFIER:
        ITEM:
          USAGE: /shop addmodifier item <player> <shop> <item> <value> [buy|sell]
          ADDED: You set &c%player%&f's %type% price modifier for the %item% item
            in %shop% shop to &c%modifier%&f.
          ADDEDBY: Your %type% price modifier for the %item% item in %shop% shop was
            set to &c%modifier%&f by &c%player%&f.
        SHOP:
          USAGE: /shop addmodifier shop <player> <shop> <value> [buy|sell]
          ADDED: You set &c%player%&f's %type% price modifier for all items in %shop%
            shop to &c%modifier%&f.
          ADDEDBY: Your %type% price modifier for all items in %shop% shop was set
            to &c%modifier%&f by &c%player%&f.
        GLOBAL:
          USAGE: /shop addmodifier global <player> <value> [buy|sell]
          ADDED: You set &c%player%&f's %type% price modifier to &c%modifier%&f.
          ADDEDBY: Your %type% price modifier was set to &c%modifier%&f by &c%player%&f.
      CHECK:
        ITEM: This item's type is &c%material%&f with damage &c%damage%&f.
        NOITEM: You have to hold an item in your hand in order to check its type.
      CHECKMODIFIERS:
        VIEW:
          VIEW: |-
            &c%player%&f's command modifiers:
            Global modifiers:
            %global%
            Shop modifiers:
            %shop%
            Item modifiers:
            %item%
          VIEWPERMISSIONMODIFIERS: |-
            &c%player%&f's permission modifiers:
            Global modifiers:
            %global%Shop modifiers:
            %shop%
            Item modifiers:
            %item%
          ENTRY:
            ITEM: 'Item: &c%item%&f, shop: &c%shop%&f, buy: &c%buy%&f, sell: &c%sell%&f'
            SHOP: 'Shop: &c%shop%&f, buy: &c%buy%&f, sell: &c%sell%&f'
            GLOBAL: 'Buy: &c%buy%&f, sell: &c%sell%&f'
      RESETMODIFIER:
        ITEM:
          USAGE: /shop resetmodifier item <player> <shop> <item> [buy|sell]
          RESET: You reset &c%player%&f's %type% price modifier for the %item% item
            in %shop% shop.
          RESETBY: Your %type% price modifier for the %item% item in %shop% shop was
            reset by &c%player%&f.
        SHOP:
          USAGE: /shop resetmodifier shop <player> <shop> [buy|sell]
          RESET: You reset &c%player%&f's %type% price modifier for all items in %shop%
            shop.
          RESETBY: Your %type% price modifier for all items in %shop% shop was reset
            by &c%player%&f.
        GLOBAL:
          USAGE: /shop resetmodifier global <player> [buy|sell]
          RESET: You reset &c%player%&f's %type% price modifier.
          RESETBY: Your %type% price modifier was reset by &c%player%&f.
  MODIFIER:
    INVALIDAMOUNT: Invalid modifier value specified. Valid values are for instance
      0.50 which is 50%, 2.0 which is 200% etc.
    INVALIDTYPE: Invalid modifier type specified. Valid values are buy, sell and both.

# MythicHUD by wordandahalf and Mythic

# If the default files should be generated.
generate-default-files: false

# If the unicode text files should be generated.
generate-unicode-files: false

# If old shaders should be allowed to regenerate. Do not disable this unless you know what you're doing.
allow-shader-update: true

layout:
  # The layouts that every user starts with.
  default:
    - 'medieval-hotbar-layout'

# The default value for how often placeholders should check for an update.
check-update: 5

# The way that numbers are displayed.
decimal-format: '#.##'

# If you would like to copy the built-resource pack to a different location.
copy-resource-pack:
  enabled: false
  # The location to copy each namespace to. The parent path is your plugins directory.
  namespaces:
    minecraft: "ItemsAdder/contents"
    mythichud: "ItemsAdder/contents"

boss-bar:
  # The maximum amount of shown boss bars a player can hold.
  max: 7
  # Which bossbar the huds display on.
  hud-position: 4
  color: yellow

# Disable the huds for any players connected through geyser.
disable-geyser-players: true

# Do not change this.
config-version: 6
